name: Personalizer
description: A drag-and-drop canvas for building personalized web pages and creatives. You place text, images, buttons, forms and videos, drop in {{tokens}} such as {{firstName}}, and preview the page as each contact would see it.
shortDescription: Build a page on a canvas and personalize it per contact with tokens.
fullDescription: Personalizer is a visual canvas editor. You add elements (Heading, Text, Image, Button, Form, Video, Spacer, Container) from the left sidebar, position them freely, and type tokens like {{firstName}} or {{company}} into text and link fields. Choose an Active Contact and the canvas shows the page with that person's details filled in; Preview Personalized refreshes it and Export HTML produces a standalone page. A Personalization hub in the sidebar holds client profiles, an asset library, AI Assist and website discovery. Content sent from other studios arrives as a Source panel with a Return button. The same personalization system (a modal with Find My Brand, Find Local Business, client profile, assets, prompt and engine sections) powers the Personalize buttons in other studios.
bestFor: Marketers, agencies and freelancers who need many personalized variants of one page or creative, each filled with a contact's or client's own name, company, logo and offer.
whenToUse: You want one landing page or creative that shows a different name, company or offer per contact.
You want to preview how a page looks for a specific contact before sending.
You received content from another studio and want to personalize it.
You need a quick standalone HTML export of a designed page.
You want to store client profiles and brand assets once and reuse them.
whenToUseAnother: Use Lead Finder (#/leadfinder) when you need to find local businesses to personalize for.
Use Find My Brand (#/find-my-brand) when you only want to pull a business's logo, photos and branding from its website.
Use Timeline Editor (#/timeline) when the thing to personalize is a video edit.
Use Website Builder (#/website-builder) when you want a full website rather than one canvas page.
Use Video Render (#/render) to export an existing video.
keyFeatures: Canvas with 8 element types: Heading, Text, Image, Button, Form, Video, Spacer, Container
Canvas size presets: Blank 1280x720, Landing Page 1280x800, Email 600x800, Social Post 1080x1080, Story 1080x1920, Banner 728x90, plus custom W and H with Apply Size
Token chips such as {{firstName}} that insert into the selected element
Active Contact dropdown (default - None -) to preview with real contact data
Preview Personalized and Export HTML actions
Save Canvas and Load Canvas (stored in your browser, with an integrity check)
Properties panel per element (position in percent, size in pixels, text, source URL, link URL, colors, fonts)
Upload image... / Replace asset... stored in your Asset Library
Personalization hub: client profiles, asset library, AI Assist, Discover from website
Source panel with Return to <studio> and Dismiss Source for content sent from other studios
Delete or Backspace removes the selected element

featureExplanations.explanation: Click Heading, Text, Image, Button, Form, Video, Spacer or Container in the sidebar to add that element. A toast says 'Added <name>'. New text elements start with the text 'Double-click to edit text. Use {{token}} for personalization.'
featureExplanations.restrictions: Spacer and similar elements do not support tokens.

featureExplanations.explanation: Pick a preset (Blank, Landing Page, Email, Social Post, Story, Banner) or type W and H and click Apply Size. If a field is empty it falls back to 1280 by 720.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Match the page to where it will be used.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: Optional width and height in pixels.

featureExplanations.explanation: Tokens are placeholders in double curly braces. The chips in the sidebar cover names (firstName, lastName, fullName), company (company, companyName), title, email, location, industry, companySummary, painPoint, product, service, interest, buyingSignal, tone, brandColor, logoUrl, avatarUrl, image tokens (productImageUrl, brandImageUrl, ctaImageUrl, firstFrameUrl, lastFrameUrl), social links (github, linkedin, twitter, website) and business fields (businessName, businessPhone, productService, offer, ctaHeadline, callToAction, brandDescription). Select an element and click a chip, or type the token yourself. Older labels like {{First Name}} also still work.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: A selected element and a contact with data.
featureExplanations.restrictions: If no element is selected you get 'Select an element first'; some element types give 'This element type does not support tokens'. Without a contact you see 'No contact selected - showing base content'.

featureExplanations.explanation: The Active Contact dropdown lists your saved profiles. Choosing one fills tokens with that contact's data. Preview Personalized refreshes the view and shows 'Preview updated'.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Check the result for each recipient.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: At least one saved contact profile.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Empty token values may stay blank or show the base text.

featureExplanations.explanation: Export HTML opens the personalized page in a new window as a standalone page titled Personalized Page.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Share or host the page elsewhere.
featureExplanations.restrictions: If the browser blocks the window you see 'Popup blocked - please allow popups for this site'.

featureExplanations.explanation: Save Canvas stores your elements and size in this browser and says 'Canvas saved'. Load Canvas restores it ('Canvas loaded'). The saved data has a checksum so damaged data is rejected.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Continue later on the same browser.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Saved only in this browser (local storage); not shared across devices. Messages: 'Save failed - storage may be full', 'No saved canvas found', 'Saved canvas appears corrupted', 'Saved canvas integrity check failed', 'Failed to load canvas'.

featureExplanations.explanation: Selecting an element shows '<type> Properties' with X (%), Y (%), Width (px), Height (px), plus Text, Source URL, Link URL, Background, Color, Font Size, Font Family and Font Weight where they apply, and 'Tokens in this element' listing detected tokens. X and Y are limited to 0-95 percent and width and height to at least 40.
featureExplanations.restrictions: If nothing is selected: 'Select an element to edit its properties.'

featureExplanations.explanation: On an Image element, Upload image... stores the file in your Asset Library so it can be reused across studios without re-uploading (hint: 'Stored in your Asset Library - reused across studios without re-uploading.'). The button then reads Replace asset...
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Use your own logos and photos.
featureExplanations.restrictions: If the upload fails the button shows an error message or 'Upload failed'.

featureExplanations.explanation: At the bottom of the sidebar. It holds client profiles ('No client profile yet. Create one to personalize every studio render.'), an asset library with categories such as Person, Logo, Product, Brand, First frame and Last frame, an AI Assist box (placeholder: describe the edit, e.g. 'remove the background and brighten the logo') and 'Discover from website', where you paste a website URL to import its images.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Reuse client data and brand assets everywhere.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Website discovery needs sign-in ('Sign in to run website discovery'). Messages include 'Enter a website URL to discover its images.', 'The discovery service is busy - try again in a moment.', 'Discovery timed out. The site may be too slow - try again.', 'No assets found on that page.'

featureExplanations.explanation: When another studio sends content here, a Source section lists the fields. Return to <studio> goes back, and Dismiss Source clears it ('Source content dismissed').
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Move generated content into personalization and back.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Handoff lives only in the current tab (session storage). A bad route shows 'Invalid return route'.

featureExplanations.explanation: Personalize buttons in other studios open a full-screen modal. It has sections Overview, Discovered, Client Assets, Saved Assets, Preview, Business, Prompt, Output, Mode and Engine. You can pick Me, My Business or Client, save a client ('Save Client' or 'Update Client'), write a prompt and click Personalize Prompt, then generate. Output choices include Prompt, Video or Image, and Everything (prompt plus media plus assets plus CTA). Modes include Face Only, Full Presenter, Recreate For Client and Complete Personalization for video, and Keep This Design, Replace Face, Replace Person, Recreate For Client and Complete Personalization for images. The Engine section offers SmartVideo Recommended plus aspect ratio, resolution, quality and duration selectors.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Turn a demo or creative into a version for a specific business.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: Business or client details and assets.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Results show Original and Personalized side by side; failures say 'We Could Not Complete This Personalization' while keeping your inputs.

howToUse: 1. Open Personalizer from the Apps hub or go to #/personalizer. 2. Choose a canvas size (for example Landing Page) or type W and H and click Apply Size. 3. Click Heading, Text, Image, Button, Form or Video in the sidebar to add elements. 4. Click an element and edit it in the Properties panel (text, Source URL, Link URL, colors, fonts, position). 5. Click a token chip such as {{firstName}} to insert it into the selected element, or type the token yourself. 6. Under Personalization choose an Active Contact. 7. Click Preview Personalized to check the result. 8. Click Save Canvas to keep your work in this browser. 9. Click Export HTML to open the finished page. 10. Press Delete to remove a selected element.
howToSteps: Insert tokens into text or link fields.
Click Save Canvas and then Export HTML.
gettingStarted: Start with the Landing Page preset and add a Heading containing {{firstName}}.
Create or pick a contact in the Personalization hub so previews have data.
Save Canvas early; storage is local to your browser.

inputDetails.name: Active Contact
inputDetails.description: Which saved profile fills the tokens.
inputDetails.whenToUse: When previewing or exporting for one person.
inputDetails.restrictions: Default is - None -, which shows base content.

inputDetails.name: Tokens
inputDetails.description: Placeholders like {{company}} in text or URL fields.
inputDetails.whenToUse: Where content should change per contact.
inputDetails.restrictions: Only some element types support tokens.

inputDetails.name: Image file
inputDetails.description: Uploaded to your Asset Library from an Image element.
inputDetails.restrictions: Upload errors are shown on the button.

inputDetails.name: Website URL
inputDetails.description: Used by Discover from website to import images.

modeExplanations.description: Prompt and asset personalization for generated images and videos.

outputs: Personalized prompts, images or videos (from the personalization modal in generative studios)
limitations: Saved canvases live in this browser only.
Token resolution needs a contact with data.
Pop-up blockers can stop Export HTML.

limitationDetails.impact: Clearing browser data loses the canvas.
Export HTML window does not open.
limitationDetails.workaround: Allow popups for this site and click again.

troubleshooting: Select an element first: click an element on the canvas before inserting a token.
This element type does not support tokens: use a Text, Heading, Button or similar element.
No contact selected - showing base content: choose an Active Contact.
Popup blocked: allow popups for this site and click Export HTML again.
Save failed - storage may be full: free up browser storage or export your HTML.
Saved canvas integrity check failed: the saved data was altered or damaged; rebuild and save again.
Discovery asks you to sign in: sign in, then paste the website URL again.

steps: Check the token name matches a chip (for example firstName).
If you see No saved canvas found, it was never saved in this browser.

commonProblems.whyItHappens: No contact is selected or the profile lacks that field.
commonProblems.howToFix: Pick a contact and fill in the missing field.

commonProblems.problem: Element cannot be moved off the edge
commonProblems.whyItHappens: X and Y are limited to 0-95 percent.
commonProblems.howToFix: Use width and height to resize instead.

faqs.question: What are tokens?
faqs.answer: Placeholders written like {{firstName}} that are replaced with a contact's real details when you preview or export.

faqs.question: Where is my canvas saved?
faqs.answer: Save Canvas stores it in your browser. It is not synced to other devices.

faqs.question: How do I delete an element?
faqs.answer: Select it and press Delete or Backspace; you will see 'Element deleted'.

faqs.question: What canvas sizes are available?
faqs.answer: Blank 1280x720, Landing Page 1280x800, Email 600x800, Social Post 1080x1080, Story 1080x1920 and Banner 728x90, or any custom size.

glossary.Token: A placeholder in double curly braces that is replaced with a contact detail.
glossary.Canvas: The free-form area where elements are placed.
glossary.Active Contact: The profile used to fill tokens in the preview.
glossary.Handoff: Content sent from another studio into Personalizer.

tips: Keep a few sample contacts so you can flip between them while previewing.
Use short, clear tokens like {{company}} in headings.
Save before you leave the page.
bestPractices: Preview with at least two different contacts.
Export HTML as your backup copy.
Reuse uploaded images through the Asset Library.
